description.content:
This resource allows partners to access their users' training data. All time values are UTC except start-time. Start-time is the time set on the training computer. Each transaction will consist of at most 50 training sessions. Available data presented in section [Schemas](#schemas). Only data that has been uploaded to Flow after the user has been registered to your client will be available. Only data that has been uploaded in the last 28 days will be available.

This resource is deprecated. Please use non-transactional [Exercises](#exercises) instead.

Check for new training data and create a new transaction if found. Only data uploaded to Flow in the last 30 days will be available. Only data that has been uploaded to Flow after the user is registered with your client will be available.
